summary: Iteration 149 Life Member Club + Medallion Club: all 9 backend pytest cases pass and full end-to-end UI flow validated on public URL. Admin sees 4 tabs on /awards (catalog, Of The Year, Life Member Club, Medallion Club). Life Member blurb renders correctly, admin can add a historical entry and delete it (list refreshes). Medallion Club renders Bronze/Silver/Gold sub-tabs, each with medal image (customer-assets URL loads over http), criteria bullets, description, Current Recipients section, and green 'Suggested Grants — MEETS ALL 5 CRITERIA' panel. Non-admin sees blurb+list but NOT the Add button (RBAC ok).

issues: 'Current Recipients (0)' empty-state text is rendered outside the data-testid=medallion-holders-{tier} grid so the testid element is not present when zero holders. Non-blocking — it appears only when at least one grant exists, which matches the spec. Consider wrapping the empty-state in the same testid for automation completeness.

critical_code_review_comments: life_and_medallion.py (~340 lines) is clean and focused; async/await used consistently for db ops; _id excluded from all reads via projection; RBAC via admin_tab_dep('awards').
Duplicate-user prevention on Life Member POST returns 409 as required.
Medallion eligibility sort key correctly places eligible members first, then by criteria_met_count desc — verified by test.
